description: The plot illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output values below a threshold of 1e-2 and 1e-3, comparing the proportion of output values before and after gating. The x-axis represents the layer number, ranging from 0 to 20, with a tick label interval of 5. The y-axis measures the sparsity ratio, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with a tick label interval of 0.2. The plot includes three lines: a dashed blue line representing the sparsity ratio before gating, an orange dotted line representing the sparsity ratio after gating, and a green dash-dot line representing the sparsity ratio after average gating. The dashed blue line starts at a sparsity ratio of approximately 0.03 and remains relatively flat across the layers. The orange dotted line starts at a sparsity ratio of approximately 0.44 and shows a general decline with some fluctuations, ending at a value around 0.33. The green dash-dot line starts at a sparsity ratio of approximately 0.33 and also shows a decline with fluctuations, ending at a value around 0.33.
